(root).purpose: Defines the main Vue application layout and injects structured data (Schema.org JSON-LD) for the Cinemagoria organization and website into the document head.

(root).purpose: Defines the multi-stage Docker build process for the Cinemagoria Nuxt application, including dependency installation, build, and a lean production runtime.
(root).notes: Uses a pinned Node.js 22-slim image to avoid a specific `node-fetch` v2 gzip issue with `@libsql/client`.
